summary: OpenAI announced an initiative to support democratic oversight bodies in overseeing government use of AI for national security, including $5 million in training, technical support and credits, and pilot tools for reviewing AI-assisted government decisions.

practices.reason: The initiative describes pilot tools for reviewing records of AI-assisted decisions, a monitoring-adjacent practice, but it is aimed at government oversight bodies rather than a transferable engineering method.
practices.quote: We will work with oversight institutions to pilot tools that help authorized reviewers examine the records surrounding AI-assisted government decisions including relevant inputs, outputs, and tool use, to better understand how AI affected outcomes.
